title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 4: seven women and one man, Yahweh's beautiful branch, and the cloud and fire over Mount Zion.

questions.text: How many women shall take hold of one man in that day?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day."

questions.text: What do the seven women say they will provide for themselves?
questions.explanation: The women say, "We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing."

questions.text: What do the women ask the man to take away?
questions.explanation: They say, "Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach."

questions.text: What will be beautiful and glorious in that day?
questions.explanation: The text says, "In that day, Yahweh's branch will be beautiful and glorious."

questions.text: For whom will the fruit of the land be the beauty and glory?
questions.explanation: The fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

questions.text: What shall he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem be called?
questions.explanation: The text says that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy.

questions.text: Among whom are those who remain written, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: It speaks of everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem.

answers.text: Among the priests of the temple
Among the nations of the earth

questions.text: By what will the Lord wash away the filth of the daughters of Zion?
questions.explanation: The Lord will wash away the filth of the daughters of Zion and purge the blood of Jerusalem by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.

answers.text: By rivers of pure water flowing from the temple
By the hands of the priests and the Levites
By the spirit of justice and the spirit of burning
By hyssop and the oil of anointing

questions.text: What will Yahweh create over Mount Zion by day?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night.

questions.text: From what will the pavilion be a refuge and a shelter?
questions.explanation: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
